description: Elections Commission - Notice for Local Authorities in Batticaloa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a "Notice of Poll" issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, announcing the specific date and time (March 09, 2023, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.) for elections to be held in various local authorities within the Batticaloa District. It falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7), which covers election announcements, schedules, and related electoral processes.
